claim_limit: This map classifies current coupling. CORE_PORTABLE means the audited surface has no known Hermes implementation dependency; it does not by itself prove live multi-runtime behavioral parity.

classifications.CORE_PORTABLE: Runtime-neutral contract/logic with no known direct Hermes implementation dependency in the audited surface.
classifications.ADAPTER_BOUNDARY: Intentional boundary that knows about one or more runtime/provider interfaces but should keep runtime semantics outside portable core.
classifications.HERMES_SHAPED: A surface intended to participate in general product behavior but currently embeds Hermes-specific names, states, paths, lifecycle semantics, or assumptions.
classifications.RUNTIME_SPECIFIC_BY_DESIGN: A Hermes-specific distribution/integration surface whose runtime coupling is intentional and should remain behind an adapter or packaging boundary.
classifications.UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_PROOF: A mixed or insufficiently isolated surface; portability must not be claimed until coupling is split or executable evidence exists.

policy.direction_rule: portable core may define contracts used by adapters; portable core must not import Hermes implementation modules
